title: 第7章 高空试探第8章 我是人渣
lines: 叶风离开瀑布后，又走了两天，今天早上他踏上了山林里的荒野小道，顺着小道一路南行，终于回到了一片颇为巨大的山谷盆地。
此处鸟语花香，空气清新，简直就像是世外桃源一般。
山谷盆地内，种植着大片的奇花异草，没有一种是叶风见过的。
刚到药圃外围，远远的便看到一群人聚集在一起。
犹豫片刻，最后还是朝着人群走了过去。
刚靠近人群，就有人在喊“叶风回来啦！
郭师兄，叶风回来啦！”
然后叶风便看到那群人哗啦啦的朝着自已这边跑来。
他心中大惊，却只能强装镇定。
郭文封箭步上前，冷冷的道：“叶风，你还敢回来！
来人，把他拿下！”
叶风一脸懵逼模样。
这是装出来的。
此刻的他，心中暗暗松了一口气。
“你还敢回来？”
短短的五个字，足以说明，这些人并不知道原主已经死了，以为他失踪了，或者因为某种原因潜逃了。
叶风此刻在观察着众人的表情。
自已从坟墓里爬出来，一定会吓凶手一跳，若是凶手就在此处，肯定会露出马脚的。
可是他失败了，眼前有几十个穿着一样的药童围在自已跟前，根本就看不清楚每个人的表情变化。
人群后面，林易、许开，此刻表情很奇特。
震惊，错愕，不解……
各种情绪此刻都堆在二人的脸上。
“你不是说把他埋了吗？他怎么还活着？你不会是把他放了吧。”
林易狠狠的瞪着许开，低声说着。
许开也是一头雾水。
他低声道：“林师兄！
你要相信我，我确实把他埋了！
而且……那晚我带走他时，他已经死了啊！”
林易表情迅速的平静下来。
没错，那日他也亲自检查过叶风的身体，死的透透的，然后才让许开将尸体处理掉的。
林易不相信，一个死人，竟然在头七之日竟然又复活了！
此刻林易有点骑虎难下。
叶风这家伙若是当众说出当日之事，自已可就惨了，弑杀同门，乃是大罪啊，自已就算是掌门的弟子，也会受到严惩！
就在林易与许开不知如何应对时。
忽然听到叶风在喊：“你们都是谁啊？放开我！
快放开我！”
郭文封道：“叶风，连我你都不认识了？”
叶风一脸迷茫的道：“你是谁？”
“你不记得我了？”
郭文封眉头一皱。
叶风轻轻摇头。
郭文封又问道：“你这七天去了哪里？”
“我也不知道，几天前的一个晚上，我从一座山峰后面的乱坟岗的坟墓里爬出来的，我什么都不记得了。”
content_en:
After Ye Feng left the waterfall, he walked for two more days. This morning he set foot on the wilderness trail in the mountain forest, followed the trail southward, and finally returned to a rather huge valley basin.
The birds are singing, the flowers are fragrant, and the air is fresh. It's like a paradise.
In the valley basin, there are large areas of exotic flowers and plants, none of which Ye Feng has ever seen before.
As soon as we arrived at the outskirts of the medicine garden, we saw a group of people gathering in the distance.
After hesitating for a moment, he finally walked towards the crowd.
As soon as they got close to the crowd, someone shouted "Ye Feng is back!"
Senior Brother Guo, Ye Feng is back! "
Then Ye Feng saw the group of people rushing towards him.
He was shocked, but he could only pretend to be calm.
Guo Wenfeng stepped forward and said coldly: "Ye Feng, how dare you come back!
Someone, take him down! "
Ye Feng looked confused.
This is an act.
At this moment, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
"You still dare to come back?"
Just five words were enough to show that these people did not know that the original owner was dead, and thought that he was missing or absconding for some reason.
Ye Feng was observing everyone's expressions at the moment.
If you climb out of the grave, you will definitely scare the murderer. If the murderer is here, he will definitely show his flaws.
But he failed. There were dozens of medicine boys wearing the same clothes surrounding him, and he couldn't see clearly the changes in everyone's expressions.
Behind the crowd, Lin Yi and Xu Kai had strange expressions at the moment.
Shocked, stunned, puzzled...
All kinds of emotions were piled on their faces at the moment.
"Didn't you say you buried him? Why is he still alive? Didn't you let him go?"
Lin Yi stared at Xu Kai fiercely and whispered.
Xu Kai was also confused.
He whispered: "Senior Brother Lin!
You have to believe me, I did bury him!
And... when I took him away that night, he was already dead! "
Lin Yi's expression quickly calmed down.
That's right, he personally checked Ye Feng's body that day and found that it was completely dead before letting Xu Kai dispose of the body.
Lin Yi didn't believe that a dead person was resurrected on the first seven days!
At this moment, Lin Yi was a bit stuck.
If Ye Feng tells what happened that day in public, he will be in trouble. Killing a fellow sect member is a serious crime. Even if he is the disciple of the sect leader, he will be severely punished!
Just when Lin Yi and Xu Kai didn't know how to deal with it.
Suddenly I heard Ye Feng shouting: "Who are you? Let me go!"
Let me go! "
Guo Wenfeng said: "Ye Feng, you don't even recognize me?"
Ye Feng said with a confused look: "Who are you?"
"You don't remember me?"
Guo Wenfeng frowned.
Ye Feng shook his head gently.
Guo Wenfeng asked again: "Where have you been for the past seven days?"
"I don't know. One night a few days ago, I crawled out of a mass grave behind a mountain. I don't remember anything."
title_en: Chapter 7 High Altitude Test Chapter 8 I am a scumbag
